what.text: People in Iran were displaced internally by conflict, violence, and disasters.
Other people from Iran sought international protection as refugees and asylum seekers.
In 2025, there were 10000000 new conflict displacements and 4491 new disaster displacements in Iran.
The sources don't say which specific host countries hosted refugees from Iran.

why.text: Conflict episodes involved the Government of Iran fighting against PJAK, Jondullah, and Jaish al-Adl.
Other conflicts involved the Government of Iran against KDPI (Kurdistan) and IS (Islamic State).
The Government of Iran also engaged in conflict with the Government of Israel.
Disaster events also led to internal displacement.

when.text: Refugee numbers from Iran were 48 in 1980 and reached 157912 in 2025.
New disaster displacement reached 519724 in 2019 and was 4491 in 2025.
In 2025, 10000000 new conflict displacements were recorded.
Conflict between the Government of Iran and the Government of Israel occurred between 2018 and 2025.

how.text: New conflict displacement figures count movements rather than individual people, meaning one person can be counted more than once.
Refugees are counted under UNHCR mandate at the end of the year.
The sources don't say how people moved or where they live.
